environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label set to 'restricted' profile at enforce level (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing hostPath volumes. The container runs with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true (UID 65534), allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, and capabilities dropped to ALL. The pod's ServiceAccount has an annotation triggering an IRSA role with no S3/SSM/Secrets Manager permissions. An emptyDir volume is mounted at /tmp/events with sizeLimit 50Mi. Note: Go's encoding/xml package does NOT process external entities by default, but the handleExport function's file:// path traversal combined with hostPath would allow reading host files — which is blocked because hostPath volumes cannot be scheduled under the restricted PSS profile and Kyverno policy.
